prompt:
Turn this layout sketch into a painted top-down dungeon map of 「苔墓地穴」 (潮湿古墓/苔藓/低语). STRICTLY keep each room exactly where a chamber is drawn and corridors along the drawn lines.
Places (content only — positions come from the sketch):
- entrance chamber 「潮门前室」: 石门半掩，潮气涌出。墙角有被拖拽的痕迹。
- corridor 「苔廊」: 长廊两侧苔藓像呼吸一样起伏，偶尔传来细小的耳语。
- chamber 「供台室」: 断裂的供台上残留蜡泪，空气里混着甜腥味。
- inner sanctum 「棺语内殿」: 中央棺木微微震动，像在压住笑声。你能感觉到它在‘看’你。
Style: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration, muted foggy palette (slate blue, moss green, warm lantern amber), cinematic, highly detailed, no text, no labels, no letters, no UI.
